title: Password Reset
description: Employees can reset their own password via the self-service portal at any time. If locked out after 5 failed attempts, contact IT to unlock the account manually. No approval required.

title: VPN Access
description: VPN access is granted automatically to all full-time employees. Contractors require manager approval submitted via the access request form. VPN credentials expire every 90 days and must be renewed by the employee.

title: Laptop Replacement
description: Laptops are eligible for replacement after 3 years of service, or earlier in case of verified hardware failure. Requests must be raised at least 2 weeks in advance of intended replacement.

title: Software Installation
description: Requests for standard software listed in the approved catalog can be self-installed. Non-catalog software requires IT Security review, which takes 3–5 business days.

title: Printer Troubleshooting
description: For printer issues, first check the printer queue and restart the print spooler. If the issue persists after restart, log a ticket with the printer's asset tag.

title: Email Mailbox Quota
description: The default mailbox quota is 25GB. Employees nearing quota should archive old mail. Quota increases beyond 25GB require manager approval and are capped at 50GB.

title: Guest Wi-Fi Access
description: Guest Wi-Fi credentials are valid for 24 hours and can be generated by any employee from the front-desk kiosk. No IT ticket is required.

title: Expense Software Access
description: Access to the expense management tool is granted by Finance, not IT. IT can only assist with login or technical issues once an account already exists.

title: Security Incident Reporting
description: Any suspected phishing email, malware, or unauthorized access attempt must be reported to security@veridian-corp.example immediately and should not be forwarded to other employees.

title: Work-From-Home Equipment
description: Employees working remotely more than 3 days per week are eligible for a one-time home office equipment allowance, including chair and monitor. The allowance requires manager sign-off and Finance processing. IT only handles the equipment shipping request once approved.

title: Asset Management Policy
description: All company-issued hardware, including laptops and monitors, follows a standard 4-year refresh cycle from the date of issue. Early replacement outside this cycle requires Finance sign-off in addition to IT approval.
